findings.text: stopped_with_terminal_manifest reads whatever status sits at the pointer's manifest_path and never checks that the delivery belongs to the current attempt, so the repository's owner of that pairing, reckon/crew/runs.py:148 _manifest_freshness (used by _release_terminal_manifest at reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:488 via manifest_baseline_mtime_ns), is bypassed; a resumed or redispatched peer that dies before writing its own manifest leaves its predecessor's terminal manifest at the same path and is read as stopped-terminal from a verdict that is not this attempt's. It is harmless while the liveness clause also requires proven death, but the freshness check belongs here rather than being left to a second clause.
